## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`node test-app.js`)
- [ ] A new test covers the fix or feature (required for bug fixes)
- [ ] Shared code in `index.html` and `mobile.html` is still byte-identical
- [ ] Version marker on line 2 and `APP_VERSION` bumped, entry added to `features-manifest.json` (if a page changed)
- [ ] Works offline, or is clearly labelled as online and listed in "What goes online" in the README
- [ ] Failures produce a specific message; nothing fails silently
- [ ] New UI strings are German and have an entry in `i18n/en.js`, `i18n/fr.js` and `i18n/es.js` (or this pull request says which are missing)
- [ ] Privacy gate passed (`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`); no personal data in code, commits or screenshots
- [ ] No copyrighted data, no API keys
